newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - June 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Education Minister Claude Allegre calls for a "de-bureaucratization" of education administration, stresses need to boost science and technology learning.

-- Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet in an interview emphasises the need to restrain wage hikes, to pursue a policy of public deficit reduction, and to reform the economy, in order to fight unemployment.
-- CFDT labour union study sees the Robien law aimed at stemming job losses and creating new ones through employer relief on payroll charges as effective in creating and saving jobs.
-- Total turnover of French insurance companies was over 1,000 billion francs in 1996.
-- Former Prime Minister Edouard Balladur warns against the dangers inherent in political cohabitation, notably in terms of relationships with European partners.
-- Transport Minister Jean-Claude Gayssot calls into question a reform of the SNCF railway operator approved in parliament in February, according to union sources.
